attributes.additional_details: Independent investigations into all maternal deaths where concerns about care have been raised.Mandatory training for maternity staff to recognise and respond to life-threatening postnatal complications.﻿﻿﻿Stronger procedures requiring healthcare professionals to act on concerns raised by mothers and their families.﻿﻿﻿Greater transparency and accountability when maternity care failings are identified.﻿﻿﻿National implementation of lessons learned from maternal deaths to prevent similar tragedies.
attributes.background:
﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Mandatory training for maternity staff to recognise and respond to life-threatening postnatal complications.
﻿﻿﻿Greater transparency and accountability when maternity care failings are identified.

rejection.details:
Since your petition was submitted there have been two major reports published on this subject - and the Government has accepted the findings of both and plans to implement the relevant recommendations.

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a3bb59c4c7605ab567238ec/ockenden-report-review-of-maternity-services-nottingham-university-hospitals-nhs-trust-e-lay.pdf

https://www.matneoinv.org.uk/final-reports/

If you feel that something you think critical is missing from these plans for change, you can start a petition on that.
